ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS
1. Short title.
2. Insertion of new section.

No. 2] Marriage 3

I assent,
(H.E. STUART LESLIE)
Deputy Governor-General
4th January, 2023.
AN ACT to amend the Marriage Act, Chapter 174 of the
Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised Edition 2020; to
provide for the late filing of marriages; to empower
the Registrar to make regulations for the late filing
of marriages; and to provide for matters connected
therewith or incidental thereto.
(Gazetted 7th January, 2023).
BE IT ENACTED, by and with the advice and consent of
the House of Representatives and Senate of Belize and
by the authority of the same, as follows:
1. This Act may be cited as the Short title.
MARRIAGE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2022,

4 Marriage [No. 2
CAP. 174. and shall be read and construed as one with the Marriage
Act, which is hereinafter referred to as the principal Act.
Insertion of 2. The principal Act is amended by inserting immediately
new section. after section 61, the following new section–
“Late filing of 61A.–(1) Notwithstanding section 61 (2), a
marriages. marriage officer may transmit to the Registrar
a Duplicate Original Marriage Register outside
of the time prescribed in section 61 (2).
(2) The Registrar may, from time to
time, make regulations for the late filing of
marriages.”
